name: Lip Texture Detail
algorithm: Lip Texture Detail — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes lip texture rendering detail for deepfake detection:

1. **입술영역추출**: The lip region is precisely segmented per frame using lip landmarks (vermilion border, cupid's bow, lip corners, oral commissures). Both the dry lip surface and wet inner lip are analyzed.

2. **입술표면텍스처분석**: Natural lips show characteristic surface texture: vertical wrinkle lines (more prominent on lower lip), moisture-dependent specularity, and color variation from vermilion border to inner mucosa. The method analyzes texture quality at multiple scales. AI-generated lips often show either over-smoothed surfaces (lacking natural lip wrinkles) or artificial texture patterns.

3. **입술-Teeth-TongueRendering**: When the mouth opens during speech, teeth and tongue become visible. The method evaluates rendering quality of these elements: (a) teeth should show individual tooth structure with correct dental anatomy, (b) tongue position should be consistent with articulated phonemes. AI generators often produce blurred or merged teeth and simplified tongue rendering.

4. **입술MoistureandSpecularReflection**: Natural lips show moisture-dependent specularity that changes with lip movement (stretching reduces moisture, licking increases it). The method tracks specular patterns — AI generators typically don't model dynamic lip moisture, producing static or absent specular highlights.

5. **시간적텍스처일관성**: Lip texture should remain consistent across frames — the wrinkle pattern is stable, only varying in visibility with lip stretch. The method tracks lip texture features over time. Frame-to-frame texture instability — changing wrinkle patterns, flickering detail — indicates per-frame independent generation.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through lip 텍스트ure detail analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
